sky:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-view platformer environment SPRITE ATLAS, square 2048x2048, genuinely transparent background. Hand-painted gothic dark fantasy, painterly yet crisp high-resolution, evocative of Hollow Knight/Silksong environment craft but original objects. Cohesive restrained single-hue saturation, dark cores and luminous organic edges.
CRITICAL layout: upper left a 700x700 square of FULLY OPAQUE seamless dark organic terrain interior material, all four edges filled; NO transparent holes inside this material square. Upper right TWO complete large isolated environment objects, whole silhouettes, transparent padding around every tip, no cropped edges. Lower half FOUR isolated horizontal floating ledges in four separate rows. Same exact design language, edge thickness, stone/root scale and texel density in all four. Top row ledge length 1 unit, next 2 units, next 3 units, bottom 4 units. Longest ledge nearly canvas width with 100 pixels padding each side; lengths exact proportions 1:2:3:4. Every ledge horizontal level top surface, organically rounded ends and natural hanging root tufts, no abrupt square cutout, no stretching, clear vertical transparent separation between rows. Match relative surface height of all four platforms. All platforms have solid opaque rock cores, painted organic outline and delicate rim. These are sprites, NO scenic backdrop, no floating labels, no text, no gridlines, no outlines around panels, no cast shadow outside object, no UI. Clearly separate sprites so they can be segmented. Background MUST have alpha transparency.
Palette cyan teal and deep midnight blue, single primary azure hue; wind-polished pale roots with cyan moss and small blue leaves, dark blue slate cores; complete background objects: a weathered wind-carved stone spire wrapped in pale branch roots and a gnarled sky tree with flowing blue foliage.

props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D side-scrolling game environment object atlas, 3 columns by 2 rows, exact equally spaced grid. SIX completely isolated medium-size scenery silhouettes, all parts visible, generous alpha-transparent padding on all four sides of EACH object. No object may touch its cell edge. No square scenic backgrounds. No horizontal/vertical cropped silhouette edge. No text or grid lines.
Hand-painted gothic dark fantasy, crisp ink and painterly texture, delicate roots and organic curving forms, high quality, vivid yet restrained palette, coherent art direction.
Top left: cyan blue root wrapped ruined stone spire, freestanding complete; top middle: emerald green ancient hollow root shrine, freestanding complete; top right: amber ochre mushroom root arch over dark purple stone, freestanding complete.
Bottom left: cyan blue gnarled windswept tree, complete branch tips; bottom middle: emerald green gnarled old tree stump with fungi, complete roots; bottom right: amber ochre glowing crystal cluster emerging from dark aubergine root rock, complete tip and base.
Each is grounded with naturally irregular root/rock foot, viewed straight on side, same scale of brush detail. Entire canvas genuinely alpha transparent, no lighting cast onto background, no panel borders. Make each silhouette occupy only the central 75 percent of its cell so there is absolutely no clipping. At least 2000 pixels wide, detailed native source art.
props_clean: Remove all background haze and glows from the generated six-object transparent atlas; preserve complete silhouettes and alpha-transparent outer padding. Built-in imagegen edit.
